items.escena: You are a new volunteer at a science museum. Listen to the guide and repeat what she says. Repeat only once.
frases: Visitors should start on the ground floor.
The dinosaur skeletons are in the main hall.
Please don't let children climb on the displays.
Photos are allowed, but please turn off the flash.
The space exhibit was updated last year with new screens.
Every afternoon, we show a short film about how stars are formed.
If a visitor asks a question you can't answer, send them to the information desk.

items.escena: You are a new student assistant at a university library. Listen to the librarian and repeat what she says. Repeat only once.
frases: Welcome to the library help desk.
Please ask all visitors to speak quietly.
Most books are returned at the front desk.
All students need their library cards to borrow books.
If a book comes back late, there's a small fee.
The quiet study rooms are upstairs, right next to the computers.
Before we close, we always check that all the study rooms are empty.

items.escena: You are training to work at the front desk of a hotel. Listen to the supervisor and repeat what he says. Repeat only once.
frases: Greet every guest with a smile.
Breakfast is served in the garden room.
Ask each guest for the name on the reservation.
Room keys should never be left on the counter.
If a guest's room isn't ready, offer to store their bags.
Guests who'd like to check out after noon need a manager's approval.
If a guest complains about noise, apologize first and then call the security desk.

items.escena: You are taking a campus tour for new students. Listen to the student guide and repeat what he says. Repeat only once.
frases: This is the main student center.
You can buy snacks and drinks here.
The new gym opened here last month.
Most of your classes are in the science building.
The free campus bus stops in front of the library.
If you get lost, ask anyone in a green shirt like mine.
We'll finish the tour at the dining hall, and then we'll have lunch together.

items.escena: You are a new research assistant in a chemistry lab. Listen to the lab manager and repeat what he says. Repeat only once.
frases: Always wear your safety glasses in here.
Food and drinks aren't allowed past this door.
Long hair should be tied back before you start.
All chemicals must be labeled with the date they were opened.
If anything spills, tell me immediately instead of cleaning it up yourself.
Broken glass goes in the white box, not in the regular trash.
Before you go home, check that every gas valve has been completely turned off.

items.escena: You have just started working at a café on campus. Listen to the manager and repeat what he says. Repeat only once.
frases: Wash your hands before every shift.
Clean cups are kept on the top shelf.
Ask every customer if they'd like a receipt.
We checked the fridge this morning, and it's fully stocked.
The coffee machine needs to be cleaned before we close.
If someone asks about ingredients, show them the list by the register.
When there's a long line, I'll take the orders while you prepare the drinks.

items.escena: You are attending an orientation at a university gym. Listen to the trainer and repeat what she says. Repeat only once.
frases: Please bring a towel to every workout.
The lockers are just past the water fountains.
Wipe down each machine after you use it.
Weights should be returned to the rack when you're done.
If you've never used the machines, ask a trainer for help.
Group classes fill up quickly, so it's best to sign up online.
Stretching for a few minutes before and after you exercise helps prevent injuries.

items.escena: You are training to work at the information desk of an international airport. Listen to your supervisor and repeat what she says. Repeat only once.
frases: Security lines are longer than usual today.
The departure screens are updated every few minutes.
Lost items are taken to the office downstairs.
Passengers with connecting flights don't need to collect their luggage.
If a flight's been delayed, passengers should speak to their airline.
Taxis and shuttle buses leave from the lower level, just outside baggage claim.
Travelers who've lost their boarding passes can have them printed again at the service desk.

items.escena: You have a summer job at a bike rental shop in the city. Listen to the shop owner and repeat what she says. Repeat only once.
frases: Helmets are included with every rental.
Check the tires before each bike goes out.
Customers are charged by the hour, not by the day.
Bikes that are returned damaged have to be reported right away.
Most riders prefer the river path, since it's flatter and less crowded.
Remind everyone that the bike lanes downtown are closed during the weekend market.
Before you lock up, make sure the electric bikes have been plugged in to charge.

items.escena: You are assisting the instructor of an evening painting class. Listen to the instructor and repeat what he says. Repeat only once.
frases: Start by sketching the basic shapes lightly.
Resist the urge to add details too early.
Notice how the light changes the color of the fruit.
Darker tones should be layered gradually, rather than applied all at once.
It's essential that each layer be completely dry before you add the next.
What separates a decent painting from a memorable one is usually the contrast.
Having finished the final layer, step back and judge the overall balance from across the room.
